thread:
paul: Quick standup: we need to tighten the launch narrative for next week. Output: 1p battlecard, 3 SDR hooks, webinar runbook, and a short SE appendix. Keep it claim-forward.
mina: Agree. Opponents: cloud infra (managed endpoints), LLM API vendors, and self-hosted infra stacks. Different framing per foe.
dean: Suggestion for headline metric: "~30% lower inference spend at equivalent quality on conversational workloads". Defendable with our bench.
aline: Love conservative numbers. For SDRs make it plain english: no jargon. 3 hooks should be <12 words each.
paul: OK. Draft hooks: 
- "Ship generative features now, avoid surprise invoices later."
- "Keep latency consistent during spikes  users notice tails, not averages."
- "Reserve capacity with SLA-backed pools."
sam: For cloud platforms: claim + rep line: "Managed is easy until cost and tail jump. We give control + fallbacks." Rebuttal: "We route and cache to limit p95 exposure; transparent unit economics."
mina: LLM API vendors: "Fast start, poor governance at scale. Pin models, canary, rollback." Rebuttal: "Same API surface, more rollout controls and observability.

dean: Self-hosted infra: "You get control and ops debt. We offer Dedicated or Private with turnkey defaults." Rebuttal: "Avoid building an inference platform from scratch; we handle autoscale, KMS, and audits.

aline: Webinar plan (45m): 8m positioning, 20m live demo (routing + quick canary rollback + billing dashboard), 10m benchmarks + methodology, 7m Q&A/next steps. Demo checklist attached in the doc.
paul: Need 1 standout launch-post headline. Options: 
A) "Same API. Predictable economics. Production SLAs."
B) "Predictable inference, fewer surprises."
Which is tighter?
mina: A is crisp; B is softer. Lean A.
sam: Agreed, A is more shareable on social.
dean: I'll prepare a 2-line technical appendix: bench setup, dataset summary, quant settings, command to reproduce. Include `python bench/run.py --profile conv-dialog --cache on --batch 16`.
aline: SDR rebut cards: 3 short counters per opponent, each 1 line. Keep them scannable.
paul: Also add procurement quick-handles: mapping commit tiers to throughput, short TCO link, and a 1-line legal headnote on data residency/KMS for Private.
mina: I'll sketch the 1p battlecard and field two-slide summary for reps. Add a small table: claim, proof point, one-liner rebuttal, CTA.
sam: Content ops: I'll write the launch post draft and 3 social snippets. Keep the main claim and one bench stat.
dean: Ops note for the webinar demo: we need a synthetic spike generator and a pre-uploaded canary config. I'll drop scripts.
content-bot: Reminder: publish assets to CMS by 4960050000 to hit the scheduled push.
paul: Everyone, please review the draft in the doc by EOD tomorrow: https://redwood.internal/marketing/claims-refactor (placeholder). Tag with :eyes: or :pencil:. We'll lock copy 24 hours before the deploy.
mina: One more ask  include a two-sentence customer quote template for case studies. Keeps PR ready.
aline: On it. I'll add a compliance blurb for Private.
